notes.title: Rogueformer v1.0.4 changelog
notes.notes:
Here are the changes:
- Made it possible to leave Options with Escape.
- Now you can't read the achievements while Options are open in the Main Menu.
- Made the liquid in Cauldron more transparent.
- Made the tutorial drawings show only Keyboard instructions, as to not imply that playing with a controller is part of the game's design (controllers are mostly not supported, you are supposed to play with a Keyboard. The controller support as is, is only to make cooperative possible, which is just an experimental feature for the lulz and what not).
- Reduced the bomb explosion delay by 1/3.
- Added a sound of burning fuse to the bombs.

notes.title: Rogueformer v1.0.3 changelog
notes.notes:
Here are the changes:
- Spikes can no longer stack, they self-destruct upon other spikes falling on them.
- Player destroys tiles, if it gets stuck in some (for example, if entrance is obstructed upon revival).

notes.title: Rogueformer v1.0.2 changelog
notes.notes:
Here are the changes/fixes:
- Changed the Timers' font to match the rest of the game.
- Changed the font on Perk Acquired Icon names to match the rest of the game (the ones that you see when you hover over the perks in your pause menu).
- Reduced the Boss Health Bar in size.
- Reduced the size of the pause Menu (the button part).
- Reduced the size of the Options that you access via pause menu.
- Made Spikes self-destruct when they are in the ground.

notes.title: Rogueformer v1.0.1 changelog
notes.notes:
Here are the fixes/changes:
- The Shrine Texts inherit the color of the previous level. Previously, it was not the case with all of them.
- Max Hp no longer gets consumed after sacrificing at the Holy Shrines (the ones that give Blessed Perks).
- Shrines have drops now (go on, vandalise everything!!).
- 'Degradation' perk has now been assigned with a perk icon (my bad, seems I forgor to do it before).
- 'Tormenting Embrace' perk has now been assigned with a perk icon (my bad, seems I forgor to do it before).
